context.discovery: Found 2026-07-27 while draining the R-wave backlog. `gh run view 30261672366` reports total_count=0 jobs and 'This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue.' The Complete CI Pipeline has therefore executed ZERO jobs on branch claude/rte-truth-program.
context.impact: All 14 jobs — including every required PR gate (code-quality, tests, extractor-smoke, audit-validator, routing-consistency, extractor-full, extractor-lint, auditor-router) — are silently absent, not failing. PR #1136's check list looks largely green because the pipeline that would have gated it never started. This is a hollow green and would have carried straight through MERGE-001.
context.scope_note: main is unaffected; both defects were introduced on this branch by this program's own R0 packets.

defects.mechanism: GitHub Actions expression string literals are single-quoted and escape an embedded quote by DOUBLING it (''). Backslash escaping is not supported, so \'missing\' is an expression syntax error. GitHub rejects the whole workflow file at parse time and runs no jobs at all. The seven sibling lines (624-628, 630-631) use the correct form; only this one is escaped, consistent with shell-escaping leaking out of a heredoc during authoring.

defects.fix: add a trailing backslash to line 346 so the continuation reaches pytest
defects.mechanism: Inside `run: |`, line 346 ends without a line-continuation backslash, so the pytest invocation terminates there and `--timeout=120 --timeout-method=thread` is executed as a SEPARATE shell command. Under the Actions default shell (bash -e -o pipefail) this exits 127 'command not found', so extractor-full can never report success once F-55 is repaired and jobs actually run. Two consequences: the required gate is permanently red, AND the intended per-test timeout is never applied, so the full extractor suite runs unbounded. Latent today only because F-55 prevents the job from starting.

pr.title: fix(ci): repair invalid Actions expression that silently disabled the entire CI pipeline
pr.body: The Complete CI Pipeline has run ZERO jobs on this branch. A backslash-escaped string literal in a GitHub Actions expression (line 629) makes the workflow file invalid, so every required gate was absent rather than failing. A second defect (line 346) would keep extractor-full permanently red once jobs resume. Both were introduced by this program's own R0 packets, whose verify steps were substring greps that could not detect a broken workflow.
